coverage.detail: Production applied unevenly: VA1 rolled back and did not receive the new pyke release.
The VA1 replacement deployment failed its desired state because none of three allocations started.

finding.what: VA1 pyke failed to deploy and automatically rolled back after all three replacement allocations failed to start.

alternatives.hypothesis: An image, task configuration, placement, or resource error prevented allocation startup.
alternatives.discriminated_by: The three failed Nomad allocation events and bounded task startup logs.

task.title: Investigate VA1 pyke rollout failure
task.prompt: Coordinate the VA1 production pyke rollout failure. Obtain authoritative Nomad deployment status, allocation events, and bounded task startup logs for all three failed replacements; identify the startup or placement failure; verify the restored allocation count and a representative service path; then define the safest remediation and success check. Do not retry or mutate the workload without an explicit configured-operator request through Emisar.

completion.message:
VA1 pyke **did not deploy**. All three replacement allocations failed before starting, so the scheduler rolled VA1 back to the prior release. The restored workload’s current health and customer impact are unverified.

The failure boundary is allocation startup; the exact cause is not present in the notification and the current Emisar catalog has no Nomad diagnostic. The next action is to obtain the three allocation events and bounded task startup logs, fix the identified startup or placement error, then verify the replacement count reaches its declared healthy state and a representative service check passes before calling the rollout recovered.

completion.summary: The VA1 pyke rollout failure and automatic rollback are confirmed; the underlying allocation startup cause remains unverified.
